summary.text: Kristin Egan is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 142 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Joseph Hogan.

A teacher of more than 20 years and a school board director in the Neshaminy School District, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on school funding, affordability, public safety and the environment.

paragraphs.text: Kristin Egan graduated from Conwell Egan Catholic High School, earned an associate degree from Bucks County Community College in 2001, and received a bachelor's degree in 2005 and a graduate degree in 2009 from Holy Family University.
Her career has been in teaching.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a lifelong Bucks County resident and a teacher of more than 20 years who has served as an elected union officer, elected chief negotiator, curriculum coordinator and Title I coordinator.
Egan is a member of the Neshaminy School District board, representing Region 3, according to Ballotpedia.
She said in the survey that she serves on the board's Business Operations and Policy Committee.

Her survey responses name rising property taxes, the cost of living and public safety as the district's most pressing issues, and she said she would advocate for increased and fairer state school funding.
